name: OIDC-Auth
description: Advanced OIDC authentication with role-based library access control
overview: OpenID Connect SSO with granular role-to-library mapping, multi-provider support, and a full admin configuration UI.
changelog: Sync the Jellyfin profile picture from the OIDC picture claim (on by default, per-provider opt-out), with an SSRF-guarded fetch: HTTPS only, Authority-origin plus admin allowlist, private/link-local address blocking, DNS-rebinding pinning, no redirects, a 5 MiB read-time cap, and magic-byte verification. Also fixes the admin config round-trip silently resetting EmailClaim, AutoLinkByVerifiedEmail, EnforceSsoOnLink, AllowInsecureAuthority and AllowedSigningAlgorithms.
